berserker__root.title: Ruin Slash
berserker__root.description: Unlocks Ruin Slash (Level 3) (24 mana, 5.99 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__root.extra_description: Cone slash that shreds armor on up to five enemies in front of you. The first skill of the Berserker base.

berserker__bull_rush.title: Bull Rush
berserker__bull_rush.description: Unlocks Bull Rush (24 mana, 10 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__bull_rush.extra_description: Charge forward with your shoulder; the first creature you meet takes 1.5x your attack damage and blacks out, staggered like a Punishment Kick.

berserker__reservoir_mastery_iii.title: Reservoir Mastery III
berserker__reservoir_mastery_iii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

berserker__planned_twin_fang.title: Twin Fang
berserker__planned_twin_fang.description: Unlocks Twin Fang (20 mana, 8 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__planned_twin_fang.extra_description: A dash that strikes once with each hand, using both weapons' damage.

berserker__combat_mastery_i.title: Combat Mastery I
berserker__combat_mastery_i.description: Teaches Combat Mastery I, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Dodge in the middle of an attack, or attack straight out of a dodge. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

berserker__renewal_mastery_iii.title: Renewal Mastery III
berserker__renewal_mastery_iii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

berserker__reservoir_2.title: Reservoir 2
berserker__reservoir_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

berserker__planned_war_frenzy.title: War Frenzy
berserker__planned_war_frenzy.description: Unlocks War Frenzy (30 mana, 45 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__planned_war_frenzy.extra_description: Rage: attack speed and life steal for 10 s, but you take 20% more damage.

berserker__render_rush.title: Render Rush
berserker__render_rush.description: Unlocks Render Rush (Level 3) (26 mana, 11.97 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__render_rush.extra_description: Performs a frontal dash, dealing damage to anyone in the path.

berserker__renewal_mastery_i.title: Renewal Mastery I
berserker__renewal_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

berserker__haste.title: Haste
berserker__haste.description: Unlocks Haste (Level 2) (51 mana, 119.7 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__haste.extra_description: To a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

berserker__constitution_3.title: Constitution 3

berserker__renewal_2.title: Renewal 2
berserker__renewal_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

berserker__dopamine.title: Dopamine
berserker__dopamine.description: Teaches Dopamine, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Damage dealt by a dash attack is turned into stamina (4 s cooldown). Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

berserker__reservoir_3.title: Reservoir 3
berserker__reservoir_3.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

berserker__wellspring_3.title: Wellspring 3
berserker__wellspring_3.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

berserker__sparking_bloodlust.title: Sparking Bloodlust
berserker__sparking_bloodlust.description: Unlocks Sparking Bloodlust (36 mana, 45 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__sparking_bloodlust.extra_description: Roar like the Feral Claw: for 15 s your attack speed rises by 30% and each strike has a one-in-five chance to be a Black Flash (2.5x damage and a short stun).

berserker__adrenaline.title: Adrenaline
berserker__adrenaline.description: Teaches Adrenaline, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Below 20% health, deal 60% more damage and take 40% less. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

berserker__demonic_assimilation.title: Demonic Assimilation (Phase 1)
berserker__demonic_assimilation.description: Unlocks Demonic Assimilation (Phase 1) (Level 1) (0 mana, 180 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__demonic_assimilation.extra_description: Channels the power of the anti-magic demon, granting superhuman strength, speed, resistance, and flight.

berserker__vampirize.title: Essence Extortion
berserker__vampirize.description: Teaches Essence Extortion, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Heal 20% of the damage you deal. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

berserker__combat_mastery_ii.title: Combat Mastery II
berserker__combat_mastery_ii.description: Teaches Combat Mastery II, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Sprinting just after a dodge enters a Dash, which drains stamina while it lasts. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

berserker__vengeance.title: Vengeance
berserker__vengeance.description: Teaches Vengeance, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Bonus damage against whoever last hurt you; killing them grants a fading damage boost. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

berserker__bloody_legacy.title: Bloody Legacy
berserker__bloody_legacy.description: Unlocks Bloody Legacy (Level 2) (41 mana, 40 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__bloody_legacy.extra_description: Delivers a blow that strikes the ground, dealing damage to all enemies in a straight line.

berserker__lethal_focus.title: Lethal Focus
berserker__lethal_focus.description: Teaches Lethal Focus, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Every hit raises your damage up to a cap; after 2 s without acting the bonus drains quickly. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

berserker__soul_hunt.title: Soul Hunt
berserker__soul_hunt.description: Unlocks Soul Hunt (24 mana, its Epic Fight skill's own cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__soul_hunt.extra_description: Epic Fight Nightfall's Soul Hunt on the ability wheel; needs a weapon in hand and has its own cooldown; kills and guard-broken hits reset it at most twice per cast.

berserker__charge.description: Unlocks Charge (Level 3) (85 mana, 59.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
berserker__charge.extra_description: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.

berserker__dragon_glide.extra_description: Cast a unstoppable force dragon ahead the caster, deal damage to anything on its path, can break magic shield with a chance

berserker__berserker.description: Teaches Berserker, an Epic Fight Passive skill: More attack damage and attack speed the more health you are missing. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen
